episodes.name: Gifted, Episode 1
episodes.overviewEn: At the beginning of a new year at Xavier's School, Kitty Pride returns as its newest instructor; tensions between the mutants grow when Wolverine catches Cyclops and Emma Frost sharing the same bed.

episodes.name: Gifted, Episode 2
episodes.overviewEn: The X-Men confront Ord; Kitty Pryde challenges Emma Frost; the team is divided.

episodes.name: Gifted, Episode 3
episodes.overviewEn: Wolverine and Beast debate the "cure"; Cyclops visits Nick Fury.

episodes.name: Gifted, Episode 4
episodes.overviewEn: The X-Men infiltrate Benetech; Ord invades the Xavier Institute.

episodes.name: Gifted, Episode 5
episodes.overviewEn: The X-Men and Ord go to war.

episodes.name: Gifted, Episode 6
episodes.overviewEn: The X-Men and Ord go to war, but the X-Men need help to defend against him.

episodes.name: Dangerous, Episode 1
episodes.overviewEn: The heroes protect people from a monster; a depressed mutant teenager tests his power.

episodes.name: Dangerous, Episode 2
episodes.overviewEn: A fellow student dares Wing to test his lost power resulting in his death.

episodes.name: Dangerous, Episode 3
episodes.overviewEn: The students start to panic when they realize Wing is missing.

episodes.name: Dangerous, Episode 4
episodes.overviewEn: A Sentinel reawakens and seeks to destroy the X-Men.

episodes.name: Dangerous, Episode 5
episodes.overviewEn: Despite being in the Danger Room, the students are threatened.

episodes.name: Dangerous, Episode 6
episodes.overviewEn: The X-Men try to save the students in the Danger Room.

episodes.name: Torn, Episode 1
episodes.overviewEn: Strange visions and disturbing hallucinations begin affecting the X-Men, while Emma Frost struggles to understand the source of the attacks.

episodes.name: Torn, Episode 2
episodes.overviewEn: Secrets from Emma's past emerge as evidence points toward a connection between the psychic assaults and her former allies. Emma manages to disable Scott's powers; Cassandra confronts Beast.

episodes.name: Torn, Episode 3
episodes.overviewEn: The influence of the Hellfire Club casts a long shadow over the X-Men as old enemies on the battlefield and buried memories resurface.

episodes.name: Torn, Episode 4
episodes.overviewEn: Suspicion spreads through the X-Men when the attacks intensify, forcing the team to question whether one of their own is responsible.

episodes.name: Torn, Episode 5
episodes.overviewEn: With the truth finally revealed, the X-Men confront a powerful threat capable of exploiting their deepest fears and weaknesses.

episodes.name: Torn, Episode 6
episodes.overviewEn: Emma faces her greatest personal trial as the X-Men battle to overcome betrayal, deception, and the forces seeking to destroy them from within.

episodes.name: Unstoppable, Episode 1
episodes.overviewEn: The X-Men learn that a giant bullet from the Breakworld is speeding toward Earth, leaving little time to prevent a global catastrophe.

episodes.name: Unstoppable, Episode 2
episodes.overviewEn: Determined to stop the threat at its source, the team journeys back to the hostile world where the conflict first began. The mutants react to the fallout surrounding the prophecy claiming Colossus will destroy Breakworld.

episodes.name: Unstoppable, Episode 3
episodes.overviewEn: New allies emerge within Breakworld as resistance forces unite against the regime responsible for the attack on Earth. Ord and his warriors confront the X-Men and S.W.O.R.D.

episodes.name: Unstoppable, Episode 4
episodes.overviewEn: Long-standing predictions surrounding Kitty Pryde and the fate of Breakworld begin to unfold in unexpected ways. The X-Men defend Colossus as the Breakworld warlords demand his death to save their planet.

episodes.name: Unstoppable, Episode 5
episodes.overviewEn: As the countdown to impact continues, the X-Men launch a final effort to prevent the destruction of Earth.

episodes.name: Unstoppable, Episode 6
episodes.overviewEn: Faced with an impossible decision, Kitty prepares to make a sacrifice that could save billions of lives.

episodes.name: Unstoppable, Episode 7
episodes.overviewEn: The fate of Earth, Breakworld, and the X-Men is decided as Kitty confronts the unstoppable projectile in a dramatic conclusion.
